name: Tori 09 · Travel · find matches
description: Runs travel_find_matches() for each TravelIntent and notifies the requester about the best candidate. Returns only { matchFound, matchId }.

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $json.intent_id, JSON.stringify({ max_source_km: $env.TRAVEL_MAX_SOURCE_DISTANCE_KM, max_destination_km: $env.TRAVEL_MAX_DESTINATION_DISTANCE_KM, max_time_diff_min: $env.TRAVEL_MAX_TIME_DIFFERENCE_MINUTES, max_candidates: $env.TRAVEL_MAX_MATCH_CANDIDATES, w_source: $env.TRAVEL_SCORE_WEIGHT_SOURCE, w_destination: $env.TRAVEL_SCORE_WEIGHT_DESTINATION, w_time: $env.TRAVEL_SCORE_WEIGHT_TIME, consent_timeout_min: $env.TRAVEL_CONSENT_TIMEOUT_MINUTES, intent_grace_min: $env.TRAVEL_INTENT_GRACE_MINUTES, draft_ttl_min: $env.TRAVEL_DRAFT_TTL_MINUTES, max_days_ahead: $env.TRAVEL_MAX_DAYS_AHEAD, max_changes_per_hour: $env.TRAVEL_MAX_REQUEST_CHANGES_PER_HOUR, max_changes_per_day: $env.TRAVEL_MAX_REQUEST_CHANGES_PER_DAY, decline_cooldown_days: $env.TRAVEL_DECLINE_COOLDOWN_DAYS, geocode_cache_days: $env.TRAVEL_GEOCODE_CACHE_DAYS }) ] }}

parameters.jsCode:
// notifications decided by the database; workflow 11 renders and sends them
return $('Find matches').all().flatMap((i) => i.json.r.notifications || []).map((n) => ({ json: n }));

// The only thing the matcher hands back: no places, distances or other users
return $('Find matches').all().map((i) => ({ json: { matchFound: !!i.json.r.matchFound, matchId: i.json.r.matchId || null } }));
